title: Order Status and Fulfilment Standard for Cartwise Grocery Orders
content:
## Fulfilment standard — order status from checkout to close

This standard sets out how a Cartwise Grocery Orders order moves through its statuses and what may change along the way.

### Clauses

1. An order moves from placed to shopping, then to en route for a delivery service level or to ready for pickup for Curbside Pickup, then to completed at handoff.
2. Every step is recorded by the system from the shopper's app, and the agent never advances an order's status.
3. Items may be added or removed until the service level's item-edit cutoff.
4. Unattended drop-off is allowed only on service levels where leaving at the door is allowed, and never for an order containing alcohol.
5. An order closes the day after its issue-report window ends.
6. Each service level books windows of its own window length.

### Status movements

| From | To | Recorded when |
|---|---|---|
| Placed | Shopping | A shopper accepts the order's batch and starts shopping |
| Placed | Canceled | The customer cancels before shopping starts |
| Shopping | Canceled | The customer cancels while the order is being shopped, before checkout |
| Shopping | En route | The shopper checks out and leaves the store with a delivery order |
| Shopping | Ready for pickup | The shopper checks out and stages a pickup order at the store |
| En route | Completed | The delivery order is handed over or left at the door |
| Ready for pickup | Completed | The customer collects the pickup order |
| En route | Returned | The customer could not be reached and the order is taken back to the store |
| Ready for pickup | Returned | The pickup order is not collected within the hold time and is returned to stock |
| Completed | Closed | The issue-report window ends and the order's charges are final |
| Returned | Closed | The returned order's settlement is final |

### Unattended drop-off

| Leaving at the door allowed on the service level | Order contains alcohol | Unattended drop-off |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | Allowed |
| Yes | Yes | Not allowed |
| No | Either | Not allowed |

### Points of judgement

- *A customer asks the desk to mark an en route order as delivered* — the agent never advances an order's status; the status moves only as the system records it from the shopper's app (clause 2).
- *A customer wants to add an item after the shopper has begun* — items can be changed only until the service level's item-edit cutoff (clause 3).
